manualSources.title: SMM Hamburg 2026: Maritime industry charts a new course with battery electrification and green shipping at center stage
manualSources.summary: SMM 2026, the world's leading maritime trade fair, is underway in Hamburg (Sep 1-4) with over 2,200 exhibitors and 48,000 participants. The Energy Efficiency Hub showcases battery-electric propulsion, shore power systems, and hydrogen fuel cells for marine decarbonization. The Maritime Future Summit addresses AI-driven ship design and battery storage for offshore applications. Conference highlights include the Global Maritime Environmental Congress and the TradeWinds Shipowners Forum.

manualSources.title: LG Energy Solution secures multi-year lithium carbonate supply from Smackover Lithium for US battery production
manualSources.summary: LG Energy Solution signs a multi-year agreement with Smackover Lithium for US-produced lithium carbonate, strengthening domestic supply chain for EV and grid-scale battery manufacturing.

manualSources.title: US battery installations on track for record year in 2026 as California and Texas lead deployment
manualSources.summary: US utility-scale battery installations are projected to hit record levels in 2026, with California (62 GWh) and Texas (33.1 GWh) leading the country. The surge reflects falling battery costs and growing renewable integration demand.

manualSources.title: Lithium miners post bumper profits as battery storage demand drives price recovery
manualSources.summary: Major Chinese lithium producers Tianqi Lithium and Ganfeng Lithium report strongest net income in three years for H1 2026, driven by surging demand from the energy storage sector.

manualSources.title: Enphase Energy opens US pre-orders for IQ Battery C80, its first commercial battery storage system
manualSources.summary: Enphase launches the IQ Battery C80, an 80 kWh AC-coupled commercial storage system with integrated microinverters delivering up to 40 kVA continuous power. Shipments expected in H1 2027.

manualSources.title: Chery begins solid-state battery road testing with plans for 2027 commercialization
manualSources.summary: Chinese automaker Chery announces road testing of solid-state battery-equipped vehicles, targeting commercialization in 2027 as the race for next-generation EV batteries intensifies.

manualSources.title: Altilium secures UK patent for breakthrough EV battery recycling technology
manualSources.summary: UK-based Altilium获得 patent for innovative EV battery recycling process that recovers critical minerals including lithium, cobalt, and nickel from end-of-life batteries at higher purity levels.

manualSources.title: Form Energy raises $750M for iron-air long-duration battery storage
manualSources.summary: Form Energy closes $750M Series G round to scale its iron-air battery technology for multi-day grid storage, while Sila secures $1.4B for US battery expansion.

manualSources.title: Samsung SDI takes full ownership of Indiana gigafactory for BESS production
manualSources.summary: Samsung SDI acquires full ownership of its Indiana gigafactory, dedicated to battery energy storage system production, as US demand for grid-scale storage accelerates.

manualSources.title: EU Commission opens up to EUR 1.5B in interest-free loans for battery cell manufacturing across Europe
manualSources.summary: European Commission launches EUR 1.5B interest-free loan facility for battery cell manufacturing across the EEA, supporting the EU Battery Regulation's domestic production targets.
